prompt: Implement email_host(value). Return the domain of an address, with surrounding whitespace removed from the entire address and domain case-folded. Require a string with exactly one @ and nonempty local and domain parts containing no whitespace. Raise ValueError otherwise. Domain does not require a dot.

Implement merge_windows(windows). Given a list of (start, end) tuples of plain integers representing half-open intervals, return a new sorted list of tuples with overlapping or touching intervals merged. Drop empty intervals, raise ValueError for reversed bounds or bool/non-int bounds. Do not mutate input.

Implement parse_flags(text). Parse a string of semicolon-delimited key=value flags into a dict. Ignore empty segments. Trim key and value. Case-fold keys only. Empty values are valid. Duplicate folded keys use the last value. Split each segment at the first = only. Raise ValueError for any non-string input or nonempty segment missing a key or equals sign.
